title: Korisnik
description: Profil jednog korisnika: uređaji, sesije, epizode i svi događaji.

list.name: who
list.label: Korisnik ili uređaj
list.query: SELECT who FROM (SELECT if(user_id != '', user_id, device_id) AS who, max(ts) AS l FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY who ORDER BY l DESC LIMIT 1000)
list.definition: SELECT who FROM (SELECT if(user_id != '', user_id, device_id) AS who, max(ts) AS l FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY who ORDER BY l DESC LIMIT 1000)

options.content: Upiši ili odaberi **user_id** (Supabase) ili **device_id** gosta. Gostujući događaji s uređaja na kojima se korisnik kasnije prijavio pridružuju se njemu. Profil gore je za cijelu povijest; sesije i događaji poštuju odabrano razdoblje.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(countIf(user_id != '') > 0, 'prijavljen', 'gost') AS racun FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND (user_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR (user_id = '' AND (device_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM analytics.events WHERE user_id = ${who:sqlstring}))))

SELECT formatDateTime(min(ts), '%d.%m.%Y. %H:%i', 'Europe/Zagreb') AS prvi FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND (user_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR (user_id = '' AND (device_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM analytics.events WHERE user_id = ${who:sqlstring}))))

SELECT formatDateTime(max(ts), '%d.%m.%Y. %H:%i', 'Europe/Zagreb') AS zadnji FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND (user_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR (user_id = '' AND (device_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM analytics.events WHERE user_id = ${who:sqlstring}))))

SELECT uniqExact(session_id) FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND (user_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR (user_id = '' AND (device_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM analytics.events WHERE user_id = ${who:sqlstring}))))

SELECT uniqExact(toDate(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb')) FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND (user_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR (user_id = '' AND (device_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM analytics.events WHERE user_id = ${who:sqlstring}))))

panels.title: Vrijeme u aplikaciji

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(dwell_s) FROM (SELECT *, least(dateDiff('second', ts, leadInFrame(ts, 1, ts) OVER w), 300) AS dwell_s, ifNull(anyLast(nullIf(route, '')) OVER w_cur, '') AS screen, extract(screen, '^/(?:v|m|yt)/([^/?#]+)') AS vid, extract(screen, '^/c/([^/?#]+)') AS ch, extract(screen, '^/p/([^/?#]+)') AS person FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND (user_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR (user_id = '' AND (device_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM analytics.events WHERE user_id = ${who:sqlstring})))) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING), w_cur AS (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW))

panels.description: Procjena iz razmaka između događaja (najviše 5 min po razmaku).

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExactIf(video_id, video_id != '') FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND (user_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR (user_id = '' AND (device_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM analytics.events WHERE user_id = ${who:sqlstring}))))

SELECT device_id, platform, anyLast(browser) AS preglednik, anyLast(os) AS os, anyLast(app_version) AS verzija, anyLast(locale) AS jezik, any(concat(toString(screen_w), '×', toString(screen_h))) AS ekran, anyLast(country) AS drzava, anyLast(city) AS grad, min(ts) AS prvi_put, max(ts) AS zadnji_put, uniqExact(session_id) AS sesija FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND (user_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR (user_id = '' AND (device_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM analytics.events WHERE user_id = ${who:sqlstring})))) GROUP BY device_id, platform ORDER BY zadnji_put DESC

SELECT toStartOfDay(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') AS time, event, count() AS n FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND (user_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR (user_id = '' AND (device_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM analytics.events WHERE user_id = ${who:sqlstring})))) AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time, event ORDER BY time

panels.title: Kada je aktivan (dan u tjednu × sat)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ['pon','uto','sri','čet','pet','sub','ned'][toDayOfWeek(ts, 0, 'Europe/Zagreb')] AS dan, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 0), 0) AS `00`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 1), 0) AS `01`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 2), 0) AS `02`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 3), 0) AS `03`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 4), 0) AS `04`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 5), 0) AS `05`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 6), 0) AS `06`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 7), 0) AS `07`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 8), 0) AS `08`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 9), 0) AS `09`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 10), 0) AS `10`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 11), 0) AS `11`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 12), 0) AS `12`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 13), 0) AS `13`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 14), 0) AS `14`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 15), 0) AS `15`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 16), 0) AS `16`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 17), 0) AS `17`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 18), 0) AS `18`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 19), 0) AS `19`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 20), 0) AS `20`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 21), 0) AS `21`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 22), 0) AS `22`, nullIf(countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 23), 0) AS `23` FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND (user_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR (user_id = '' AND (device_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM analytics.events WHERE user_id = ${who:sqlstring})))) AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY toDayOfWeek(ts, 0, 'Europe/Zagreb') AS d, dan ORDER BY d

panels.title: Sesije

targets.rawSql: SELECT session_id, min(ts) AS pocetak, sum(dwell_s) AS trajanje, countIf(event = 'screen_view') AS ekrana, uniqExactIf(vid, vid != '') AS epizoda, argMinIf(route, ts, event = 'screen_view') AS ulaz, domainWithoutWWW(anyIf(JSONExtractString(props, 'referrer'), event = 'session_start')) AS izvor, any(platform) AS platforma, anyLast(country) AS drzava, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(min(ts)) - 60000 AS od_ms, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(max(ts)) + 60000 AS do_ms FROM (SELECT *, least(dateDiff('second', ts, leadInFrame(ts, 1, ts) OVER w), 300) AS dwell_s, ifNull(anyLast(nullIf(route, '')) OVER w_cur, '') AS screen, extract(screen, '^/(?:v|m|yt)/([^/?#]+)') AS vid, extract(screen, '^/c/([^/?#]+)') AS ch, extract(screen, '^/p/([^/?#]+)') AS person FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND (user_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR (user_id = '' AND (device_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM analytics.events WHERE user_id = ${who:sqlstring})))) AND $__timeFilter(ts) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING), w_cur AS (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY pocetak DESC LIMIT 500

panels.description: Klik na sesiju otvara njezin tijek. Trajanje je procjena iz razmaka između događaja.

targets.rawSql: SELECT vid AS video_id, sum(dwell_s) AS na_ekranu, countIf(event = 'screen_view') AS otvaranja, min(ts) AS prvi_put, max(ts) AS zadnji_put FROM (SELECT *, least(dateDiff('second', ts, leadInFrame(ts, 1, ts) OVER w), 300) AS dwell_s, ifNull(anyLast(nullIf(route, '')) OVER w_cur, '') AS screen, extract(screen, '^/(?:v|m|yt)/([^/?#]+)') AS vid, extract(screen, '^/c/([^/?#]+)') AS ch, extract(screen, '^/p/([^/?#]+)') AS person FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND (user_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR (user_id = '' AND (device_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM analytics.events WHERE user_id = ${who:sqlstring})))) AND $__timeFilter(ts) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING), w_cur AS (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE vid != '' GROUP BY vid ORDER BY zadnji_put DESC

SELECT if(ch != '', 'kanal', 'osoba') AS vrsta, if(ch != '', ch, person) AS slug, sum(dwell_s) AS na_ekranu, countIf(event = 'screen_view') AS otvaranja, max(ts) AS zadnji_put FROM (SELECT *, least(dateDiff('second', ts, leadInFrame(ts, 1, ts) OVER w), 300) AS dwell_s, ifNull(anyLast(nullIf(route, '')) OVER w_cur, '') AS screen, extract(screen, '^/(?:v|m|yt)/([^/?#]+)') AS vid, extract(screen, '^/c/([^/?#]+)') AS ch, extract(screen, '^/p/([^/?#]+)') AS person FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND (user_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR (user_id = '' AND (device_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM analytics.events WHERE user_id = ${who:sqlstring})))) AND $__timeFilter(ts) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING), w_cur AS (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE ch != '' OR person != '' GROUP BY vrsta, slug ORDER BY zadnji_put DESC

SELECT ts AS vrijeme_dogadaja, event, route AS ruta, video_id, channel AS kanal, platform, session_id, props, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(min(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id)) - 60000 AS od_ms, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(max(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id)) + 60000 AS do_ms FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND (user_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR (user_id = '' AND (device_id = ${who:sqlstring} OR device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM analytics.events WHERE user_id = ${who:sqlstring})))) AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 2000
